heading: Teeth whitening: questions.
items: How long does in-office whitening take?
Generally about one hour, and you choose the shade before anything starts.
Will whitening make my teeth sensitive?
In-office whitening causes little to no tooth or gum sensitivity.
Should I whiten before veneers or crowns?
Yes. Porcelain is matched to the shade your natural teeth finish at, and it will not bleach later.
How do I keep the result?
Keep up the routine and the professional cleanings, and go easy on coffee, tea, red wine and tobacco.
Where can I get my teeth whitened in McLean or Alexandria?
At the Tysons Corner office in McLean or at 2855 Duke Street in Alexandria.
